root_idea.summary: The root expresses two opposed evaluations of apportionment: equitable allocation and deviation into injustice.
root_idea.development: From the contrast between قِسْطٌ, equitable justice or a due share, and قَسْطٌ, injustice or deviation, the lexical family extends to dividing shares, measuring, and balancing. The costus term is treated separately as a homographic usage.

senses.usage_conditions: Used for equitable treatment in dealings with people or groups, including acting justly toward or between them. The Quranic forms include imperfect and imperative inflections of this verb.

senses.definition: Justice or equity; a fair apportionment of what is due.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of equitable judgment, weighing, recompense, and dealings among people. The notion of justice may be presented as a properly measured or apportioned due; the broader generic meaning “a share” is listed separately among the Classical meanings.

senses.definition: More equitable, more just, or more right.
senses.usage_conditions: A comparative adjective used when one course, attribution, or arrangement is judged more equitable than another.

senses.definition: One who acts equitably or justly.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle referring in the Quran to people characterized by equitable conduct. The separate use as a divine epithet is Classical Arabic evidence and is listed separately.

senses.definition: One who deviates from the right and acts unjustly, wrongfully, or tyrannically.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic active participle has the negative sense of deviation and injustice, contrasting with مُقْسِطٌ, one who acts equitably.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decline or deviate from the right course; to act unjustly, wrongfully, injuriously, or tyrannically.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form I verb has the negative sense associated with قَاسِطٌ; it is distinct in polarity from Form IV أَقْسَطَ, to act equitably.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distribute or apportion something among people; to assign their several portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of property, taxes, and other amounts. The same distribution sense is also reported for the undoubled form قَسَطَ in one lexical analysis.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be niggardly or parsimonious in expenditure toward one's household.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction concerning expenditure on one's dependents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide or share something among themselves equitably or equally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal Form V construction is used of parties dividing property or another thing among themselves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Costus: a fragrant wood, drug, or substance used in fumigation and medicine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Historical descriptions vary as to whether the substance is Indian or Arabian wood, aloeswood, a sea drug, or another aromatic medicinal material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion, share, or lot belonging to a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's portion of property or another divisible thing; the related sense of a fair due is distinct from this broader generic share meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's allotted share of the means of subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the portion of livelihood assigned to a created being.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quantity, especially a quantity of water, and sometimes a quantity of other things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The water-specific use is especially noted, but the term may be extended to quantity generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measure for grain or similar commodities, traditionally holding half a صَاع.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete measuring unit; the same lexical entry also records uses for vessels associated with measuring or ablution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel or mug used for a measured quantity, including a vessel used for ablution or for measuring olive oil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the vessel use in traditional ablution contexts and the urban use for a mug or liquid measure.
Reported as an interpretation of the expression describing lowering and raising the qist; this is a specialized lexical interpretation distinct from the noun’s justice sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A member of the party of Muʿāwiyah, or one of the people of Ṣiffīn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A special historical application of the plural قَاسِطُونَ.
A reported contrary use of the active participle, opposite to the Quranic negative sense of قَاسِطٌ.
A reported alternative lexical analysis restricts the Form IV family to division; the Quran-attested use of the form in the supplied evidence is equitable action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A register recording a person’s portion or share of property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive naming the written record of an allotted share.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Equitable, as a divine name or epithet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized theological use of the active participle, separate from its Quranic reference to human actors who act justly.

cautions: The root exhibits a lexical polarity contrast: قَسَطَ and قَاسِطٌ denote deviation or injustice, while أَقْسَطَ and مُقْسِطٌ denote equitable action.
The Form IV entry records an alternative analysis connecting أَقْسَطَ with division, but the Quranic occurrences supplied here support its equitable-action sense.
قُسْطٌ meaning costus is a homographic medicinal term; it is kept separate from the justice, share, and measure branches.
